name: join-wildcard-projections
description: Compare left, right and dual qualified wildcard JOIN projections

queries.name: left-star
queries.sql: SELECT a.* FROM accounts a JOIN accounts b ON a.user_id = b.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: right-star
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, b.* FROM accounts a JOIN accounts b ON a.user_id = b.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: both-stars
queries.sql: SELECT a.*, b.* FROM accounts a JOIN accounts b ON a.user_id = b.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20
